lead: A serverless pipeline that captures Amazon SES email events in near real time, streams them through Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose into S3, and makes them queryable with Athena, so email engagement and deliverability can be analysed with SQL and no servers to manage.

sections.title: Key settings
table: Every 5 minutes or 5 MiB, whichever comes first
Athena external table plus sample queries

sections.title: Design decisions
bullets: Serverless from end to end: SES, Firehose, S3 and Athena leave no servers to patch or scale.
CloudFormation is the recommended way to deploy; a console walkthrough covers the same steps.

sections.title: What is in the repository
bullets: athena/create_table.sql and athena/sample_queries.sql: the external table and example analytics queries
